8:51 PM

DEATH - The Metagame

Right so I'm beginning to understand the meta of this game in general pretty well. Alliances are powerful, making connections is crucial. I'm playing a political game, not one studded in brute force. I feel fairly confident that everyone I'm allied with genuinely wants to work with me, especially my districtmates and Camryn + Crow specifically. As I said earlier, I know how I'm perceived. People are expecting TAI CASEY to be this extreme chaotic force of danger and trolling, but I think subverting those expectations provides hella more utility than it does to meet them. Inevitably, I'm still a big name either way- this was all but confirmed to me by Muski saying that our alliance was being referred to as "Tai's group" like okay LOLLLLLLL. I've been told to my face that my reputation precedes me. Can I bat my lashes, show them the little twinkle in my eye to rizz them up into working with me? Maybe, but there's some sophistication behind being so political. A finesse and grace that I'd like to think I'm capable of, but I guess I haven't tested organic material against the pneumatic safety mechanisms. How do I intend to act upon this? Well similar things have happened in Big 4 and Kool 9 and I correctly assessed the way I was perceived so I started overplaying. I don't really see that as much as being the move oddly despite threat management working differently in this game. I don't think I need to activate immediately, I'd rather focus on being kinda floaty and socially dominant since I think my investments appreciate a lot of value the more patient I am. The time for moves is another day and I have enough faith in my foresight to determine when that will be.
8:51 PM
I know that I'm under investigation for "big threat status" with extreme prejudice. Like a skillful PR magician, I need to dazzle the audience with a cool little trick so they don't see my sleight of hand. Unlike survivor though, not everyone has to hear me out. It's the players with billy goatish headstrong tendencies that scare me, when their thoughts and preconceptions supersede my words- that's when I disappear into the long dark for good. So I'm not exactly unbothered, I think anyone trying to flip on my alliance will want my head the more time passes, but right now my big name status works in my favor, as it's GuyGuard who the grim reaper has by the throat right now and not me. Learning the map and expanding my influence is the name of the game right now. Insulate socially and seat myself as a power player then use my info to strike deals with the others I view as the power players, call it the mafia's playbook, but the streets are crawling with Sopranos- some would say that Everyone is Mafia... ...Mafia? I don't see myself as the godfather this game. A little political, perhaps- but I do really like the people I'm working with. I'm clearly willing to do right by my allies and have demonstrated a lot of good faith this game, so it truly is a matter of whether or not people decide to shut the door on me due to clinging onto their miscalculated ideas of my character. But every new connection carries that implicit, pernicious risk and there's no way around that. There's a bit of rolling the dice both in a literal and metaphorical sense in this game. Every person I run into could be an enemy, and it just takes one unlucky encounter for things to go south. That's why I appreciated the safety of my alliance, but I have to be a little courageous, don't I? Nothing ventured, nothing ascertained...
8:51 PM

MARY - The Metaphysical

Immanuel Kant's thesis on metaphysics is one of the most poorly written pieces of garbage I've ever read. I couldn't finish it. The metagame is all synthetic, let's talk about the analytics of the game, meta exclusive. My gear is really shit, my combat abilities leave more than a little to be desired- one could consider me downright frail. This of course, was by design- I'd rather posture myself socially and integrate into a network of relationships than rely on raw stat checks and rolls (Cause let's face it, Lady Luck looks at me like a crazy ex-girlfriend, and not the Rachel Bloom sitcom.) The Ace/Bui/Cetus (ABC) Alliance scares me! They have a strong gameplan and are moving as a cohesive unit and they seem to be armed with hella gear! Purple is also sheeping them because thank god for that and yeah I don't like that I'm the plastic bobblehead mascot of our alliance to them. Maybe I'm misted, but I think I could talk my way out with them, but I'm not exactly interested in giving Little Miss Fortune the opportunity to key my metaphorical car. I've got a lot of game info though, my map is fairly developed and I know where a lot of stuff is through exchanging info. Pets up north, fish on the outer rims, ranged weapons to the west, healing items to the east. Some Oriharan info exchange has given me a lot to work with, but being isolated from my alliance makes me feel really exposed even if I am still with my main trio. Arming myself will be easy, but building a network of connections is the essence of the game in my opinion. I'd like to focus primarily on finding inroads with the other major factions and then I can go really hard into playing the game of roles.

INKSPLOTCH - The Metacognition

Like I said before, I wasn't planning on taking this game too seriously. But I've fallen in love with the format, and I've made this game somewhat of a conquest of personal development for myself. I'm not blind to the way I'm perceived by many, it doesn't surprise me at all, I've just never cared. I've been a ridiculous inflammatory troll in spec chats in the past and I will continue to be because it's funny as fuck. I know I'm arrogant and come off like I think I'm hot shit, but it's because I really am that cool. But part of my pride as Tai Casey is the variety of experience I covet in my life. In one word, I'm maximalist. I seek the fullest depth of every experience I engage myself in and I look to the future. I have lots of friends and lots of love in my life, it's a beautiful thing that I'm endlessly grateful for, that I get to be happy- but stagnancy is the enemy of fulfilment. It's time to come home to roost and I want to show the people in this game and the people watching all of me. My story in this game is one of seeking wholeness and a satisfying narrative. Sure, it's probably a savvy strategy to subvert the expectations of many that don't know me as well by being a bit more careful with my social strategic gameplay and making a sincere effort to connect with those around me instead of being some tricky gamebot- but that's not my primary motivation. To subvert the expectations of the world isn't a game move, it's a core philosophy of mine. I'm the artist that went to trade school, I'm the moody storyteller with a fratboyish disposition, I'm the dickhead with a heart of gold. It's not duality, it's something greater- maybe "polyality"? Doesn't matter what you call it, I'm nothing but Tai Casey.
8:52 PM
I think a lot of people don't know it, because a lot of people don't know me that well- I love people and I love connecting with and understanding them. You can choose to believe it or not, but there's no malice in my mind, I'm just a hedonistic goblin of self-serving individuality. People get caught up in the optics of overconfidence, the air of arrogance, the energy of ego- but you just don't get me, nobody understands me at all! I'm the happiest person I know and it's because of the profound extent to which I truly love myself. Can you truly blame me for being the happiest version of myself? Okay okay that's enough head up my ass talk. Let's come back to earth from this manic molly rant and be a bit more coherent. Basically what I'm saying is that I'm enjoying this game and I'm enjoying showcasing a side of myself that seldom rears its head in this community nowadays (cause it's been a while since I've played LOL) I like to like people, and I love to love myself. It's really as simple as that.
